g1-implement.title: G1 observable module + resumable batch CLI: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1 and dispatch constellation-implementer. Build src/physics/utilization/driver_utility_observable.py: a PURE function that given (a strictly_pre causal CarCeilingResult for constructor@round, a driver best-lap (distance,speed) trace, and the track ribbon/curvature) computes per-regime ABSOLUTE speed-deficit observables g_axis = mean(v_ideal_causal - v_real) over the 4 tiling regimes, REUSING regime_utilization._build_regime_masks and PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap. NO ratio (no v_real/v_ideal) anywhere. Emit per-(year,driver,gp,round,axis) rows with n_points and a lap-sampling sigma. ALSO a resumable batch CLI scripts/build_driver_utility_observables.py: for a (year,session_type,rounds,drivers) slice, uses session_fit.fit_best_lap_trace (LEAN, skips the MAP fit) for v_real, build_car_ceiling(strictly_pre=True) for v_ideal (one per constructor-round, cached across the two cars), persists rows to an UNTRACKED scratch DB data/driver_utility_observables.db, IDEMPOTENT skip-if-present (resumable). Reads telemetry via the existing load_quali_session seam (DB-only). Unit tests: driver-at-ceiling -> g approx 0; driver 5% slow in corners -> g>0 on corner regimes and approx 0 on straight; resume skips existing rows; NO occurrence of a division of observed by capability. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G2 and dispatch constellation-implementer. Every axis carries an EXPLICIT resolved/unresolved status: when support is thin / sigma too large, mark axis unresolved and inflate sigma via the UNRESOLVED_AXIS_SIGMA_FRAC sentinel machinery from estimate_store (REUSE it; do not invent a parallel one) -> a RESERVED high-uncertainty slot, nothing dropped silently. Produce a banked artifact (an UNTRACKED parquet/sqlite table data/driver_utility.db) with columns (year, driver, constructor, axis, delta, sigma, status, n_sessions, n_points). delta is teammate-relative (note in docstring). Unit tests: thin-support driver shrinks toward 0; status flips to unresolved below support threshold and sigma inflates; artifact schema present; every axis emitted with a status (nothing silently absent).

g3-implement.title: G3 held-out gate harness: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G3 and dispatch constellation-implementer. Build src/physics/utilization/driver_utility_gate.py: fit delta on TRAIN rounds (via G2), then on HELD-OUT rounds compute BOTH gate limbs OUT-OF-SAMPLE: (1) RECOMPOSITION: predicted v_real_axis = v_ideal_causal - delta_driver_axis; report held-out RMSE vs the delta=0 (car-only) baseline, PER AXIS. (2) PER-AXIS STRUCTURE: cross-driver variance of the per-axis-CENTERED deficit (subtract the axis mean = car/calibration offset; the variance of the centered deficit is the driver signal) -- corner axes should carry meaningful centered-variance, the straight/power axis approx 0. CRITICAL (critic SERIOUS-1): treat the straight/power axis as a CALIBRATION-CONFOUNDED NEGATIVE CONTROL (measured u_straight>1 => ceiling under-predicts straights), NOT a validated 0; falsifiable weight is on the corner axes; label it so in the output. Emit a reputational smell-test table (delta ranking vs driver reputations) explicitly labeled NON-GATING. Unit tests on SYNTHETIC data: known delta recovered out-of-sample; centering removes the car offset; a LEAKAGE SELF-TEST -- feeding a through-W (non-causal) ceiling on a HIGH-LEVERAGE early-season round must visibly INFLATE replication vs strictly_pre by a pre-committed magnitude, and null inflation is interpreted as EITHER immaterial-apparatus OR underpowered, never silently a pass.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers
